schema.title: Emission Intensity Ratio
schema.description:
A ratio recorded by an organization that converts an absolute emissions to an emissions intensity
metric. The ratio can be based on a physical (e.g., volumetric) or financial basis.

The intensity ratio is derived from an existing Emission Statement (the numerator) and is defined for a
given denominator value and unit. The denominator is defined by the Emission Intensity Ratio Unit, a
Business Metric selected by the user. It can be an official SI unit, or it can be context-based like
numbers of products, sales revenue, or units performed over lifetime of sold products.

id.description: Unique identifier of an OSDU record.

version.description: Version number of this OSDU record.

id.description: The Primary Key assigned to the Emission Intensity Ratio.

emission_statement_id.description: The Foreign Key of the Emission Statement.

denominator_value.description: The value assigned to the denominator used to compute the Emission Intensity Ratio.

is_financial_ratio.description: Identifies if this is a financial ratio. If true the referenced Financial Intensity Ratio Unit should point to a Currency.

denominator_unit_id.description: The Foreign Key of the Emission Intensity Ratio Unit used.

valid_from_datetime.description: The date and optional time from which the Emission Intensity Ratio is valid, in ISO 8601 date time standardized format.

valid_to_datetime.description: The date and optional time to which the Emission Intensity Ratio is valid, in ISO 8601 date time standardized format.

name.description: The name assigned to the Intensity Ratio.

description.description: A description assigned to the Intensity Ratio.
